stages.input: one system prompt from data/, per unit
the atoms in atomize_outputs.jsonl, batched per unit

atomize.derived_by: data/, per the unit table in atomize_inputs.jsonl
atomize.note: source_sha1 is sha1(system_prompt.md text, stripped)[:12]. verify-inputs re-derives every unit from MANIFEST.json and re-hashes it.

classify.note: Stage two's input is stage one's model-generated atoms, which exist nowhere else. It can be checked only against stage one's own saved output, never against data/. This is a weaker guarantee than the atomize stage carries, and no rerun can strengthen it.

note: Outputs are the primary record of what the models said, not a cache. Temperature 0 is not determinism: rerunning will not reproduce these.
corpus: 84 of the 102 prompts of §4.5.1: the L1 of all 54 runs, plus the freedom and improvement finals of the 48 runs whose final is not their L1

corpus_completion.note: The 18 happiness finals were not re-run; they are frozen/value_pain/ reused verbatim. Union the two artifacts to get the published 102.
